## Rep Empowerment Engine
Goal: do the rep's homework before they ever pick up the phone, and make sure a warm lead never goes cold or gets lost in a channel.

Flow: intent signal comes in → we check who we already know at the account → fill any gaps → score by real engagement + intent + role fit → route by tier. Tier 1 gets the full battle-pack, Tier 2 gets lighter nurture with a path back into Tier 1, Tier 3 just feeds paid targeting.

### Tier 1 — Handle majority of rep workload and research before they begin outreach
Talking points, drafted email + InMail, matched case study, and a day-by-day cadence.  All waiting before the rep makes contact.

### Tier 2 — Lighter touch.  Same rep
So a warm lead never goes cold or gets forgotten in a channel — once engagement crosses the threshold, this contact routes straight back into the Tier 1 branch above, no manual re-triage needed.

### Tier 3 — Keep it lean.
Not rep-facing. Just feeds an ad audience segment so the brand stays visible while the signal is weak.
